brand.name: Asylum
brand.description: Not on the site at all - no 'Asylum' brand entry exists in the site's brand index. Created in 2012 by Tom Lazuka (a former Camacho/Davidoff sales rep), in partnership with Christian Eiroa shortly after Eiroa's Davidoff non-compete expired. Lazuka pitched oversized 60-80 ring gauge cigars after seeing retailers sell out of them; Eiroa reportedly called the idea 'the worst idea he had ever heard' and named the brand Asylum as a joke at Lazuka's expense, but agreed to produce it anyway. Asylum is sold as its own standalone brand (not badged 'CLE'), but is made at Christian Eiroa's own factory - The CLE Factory (a converted 1975 movie theater) in Danli, Honduras. Blend philosophy is practical/value-driven rather than 'masterpiece' blending - Lazuka has said they started by asking what tobacco they had enough of to make a million cigars - reflected in very large ring gauges (50-80) and bold, spicy, full-flavored profiles at aggressive price points.

line.name: Asylum 13 "Split Personality"
line.description: Released June 2025. Despite the 'split personality' name/premise implying two blends, halfwheel's review found it is actually ONE blend - a Honduran puro flavored to taste like a banana split (banana, butterscotch, vanilla notes).

research_notes: Full line also comes in 4x40, 6x60, and 7x70 per retailer listings - not photographed on the Mac, not added as formal entries here.
